brief.summary_1line: Diti performs a thousand-year penance for a son to kill Indra, but Indra secretly serves her and then destroys the fetus when she breaks ritual purity.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra secretly enters the sleeping Diti's body and splits the glowing fetus into seven pieces with his mace.
Diti performs severe austerities in the forest while Indra humbly serves her with firewood, kusha grass, and gentle care.
Exhausted from penance, Diti falls asleep in an impure posture at sunset, her feet where her head had rested.
